## Description and Rationale

I am an independent participant from India with an interest in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science. I decided to register for the PRC Data Challenge to gain practical experience working with real-world aviation data and to develop a machine learning model for predicting aircraft taxi-out time. I am particularly interested in exploring data analysis, feature engineering, and machine learning techniques to solve a real-world problem and improve my skills through the challenge.
